original.value: A premium underwater commercial photoshoot featuring a sleek {argument name="product" default="Galaxy S Series smartphone"} as the hero product, held in the foreground in a selfie position and captured in sharp focus, with realistic water droplets and reflections enhancing its metallic finish and camera lenses.
